propositions: CLI facade reconstructs command identity through overlapping data structures and multiple help authorities, causing parser-help drift and maintenance overhead
Twenty-one intercept-only commands lack safe canonical help reachable via `rebar help <command>` while handler-owned `--help` is inconsistent and may execute work
A unified lazy route registry must make every command's runtime parsing and generated syntax come from a single side-effect-free argparse factory with no separate docs-only parser
Generated package-help and overview bytes must be committed and authoritative at runtime, consulted before operation/config/mount/handler boundaries, ensuring help execution remains pre-operational
Exact aliases, hidden commands, retired spellings, and historical jira-onboard must exhibit approved behavior while capability registry maps optional modes to postures without eager imports
All CLI reference, coverage, and distribution checks must enumerate registries and generated parser artifacts rather than source regexes or manual command censuses
